app.name: LastHelp
app.tagline: Report a bug or suggest an idea. No account needed.
auth.passwordHelp: A long phrase beats a short puzzle. There are no rules about symbols.
auth.setupHelp: The first account is the administrator.
board.empty: Nothing here yet. Yours would be the first.
error.already_sent: That looks like something already sent. Look for it on the board.
error.bad_credentials: That email and password do not match.
error.bad_issue: That is not an issue number or URL.
error.board_closed: This board has taken more today than a person can read. Try again later.
error.channel_incomplete: That channel is missing something it needs.
error.form_stale: This form went stale. Reload the page and send it again.
error.internal: Something went wrong here. Try again.
error.issue_not_found: There is no issue with that number.
error.kind_not_accepted: This board does not take that.
error.no_forge: This organisation is not connected to a forge.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
error.rejected: This board does not take that.
error.too_many: That was a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error.too_many_links: That has more links than a report needs.
error.update_bad_checksum: The download does not match the signed checksums. Nothing was installed.
error.update_bad_signature: That release is not signed by a key this build trusts. Nothing was installed.
error.update_container: This is running in a container, so replacing the binary would come back on the next restart. Pull a new image instead.
error.update_failed: The update did not finish. Nothing was replaced.
error.update_none: There is nothing newer to install.
error.update_offline: Outbound connections are switched off, so nothing was checked.
error.update_too_old: That release is older than this database and would not understand it.
error.update_unreachable: Could not reach the release server.
error.update_unverifiable: This build has no release keys, so it cannot verify an update. It will not install one.
error.update_wont_run: The downloaded binary did not run on this machine, so it was not installed.
form.bodyPlaceholder: What happened, and what you expected instead
form.emailHelp: Only to tell you when this changes. Leaving it blank is fine.
form.similarHelp: Voting for one of these helps more than a second copy.
form.title: Title
item.commentWaiting: Sent. A person will read it before it appears.
item.merged: This was merged into another report.
landing.emptyOperator: Nothing is set up yet — and you are the administrator, so that is one short form away.
landing.pointForge: What deserves it becomes a real issue in your forge, and the report follows it when it closes.
landing.pointNoAccount: Reporting needs no account. A title, a description, and that is the whole form.
landing.pointVotes: Ideas gather votes, so what people actually want stops being a guess.
org.forgeLead: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. It only ever needs to write issues.
org.noForgeLead: No forge, so there is nothing to connect. Reports live here and nowhere else, which is a perfectly good way to run this.
org.tokenWhere: In that forge: {where}, with the scope {scope}.
panel.addressHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It goes in the URL and cannot be changed later.
panel.channelHelp: Without this, the queue fills and nobody notices. That is how a portal dies.
panel.firstStep: Nothing here yet. Add an organisation to start — it is a connection to a forge, or to nothing at all.
panel.forgeHelp: Where issues are opened. A board works perfectly well without one.
panel.forgeOwnerHelp: The account or organisation that owns the repositories, spelled as the forge spells it.
panel.forgeRepoHelp: Only the repository name. The owner comes from the organisation.
panel.forgeURLHelp: The address of the forge itself, with no path after it.
panel.issueQueued: Queued. It will appear on the forge shortly.
panel.mergeHelp: Its votes move across, and anybody who voted both counts once.
panel.mergePlaceholder: The identifier of the surviving report
panel.name: Name
panel.nameHelp: What people see. You can change it later.
panel.tokenHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Needs permission to read and write issues.
portal.empty: Nothing has been set up here yet.
repo.acceptsHelp: At least one. You can change this later.
repo.acceptsLead: Both, unless you have a reason. A board that accepts neither is refused.
roadmap.lead: Nobody keeps this by hand: it follows what actually happens.
sent.keepLink: Keep this link. It is the only way back to your report, and it is not shown again.
sent.title: Sent
sent.waiting: A person will read this before it appears.
setup.boardLead: One board per repository. People report here; you decide what becomes an issue.
setup.doneLead: Your board is open. Anybody can report on it without an account.
setup.doneWebhook: One thing left, and it is done in your forge rather than here: add the webhook shown on the organisation's page. Without it an issue closing there will not close the report here.
setup.orgLead: An organisation groups your boards and holds the connection to your forge. One is enough to start.
update.installing: Installing. This page will come back when it restarts.
update.title: Updates
